rules.description: Child must be under 11 years old (before September after 11th birthday)
rules.reason_if_failed: Your child is only eligible until the September after they turn 11

rules.description: Disabled child must be under 16 years old (before September after 16th birthday)
rules.reason_if_failed: Your disabled child is only eligible until the September after they turn 16

rules.description: Child must usually live with the applicant
rules.reason_if_failed: Your child must usually live with you to be eligible
You cannot claim Tax-Free Childcare for a foster child. Check if you're eligible for Free Childcare for Working Parents instead.

rules.description: Applicant must be working, on leave, or starting work
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be in work or returning to work to be eligible

rules.description: Applicant must earn at least National Minimum Wage for 16 hours per week over next 3 months
rules.reason_if_failed: You must expect to earn at least the equivalent of National Minimum Wage for 16 hours a week. This is £2,539.68 per quarter if you're 21+, £2,080 if 18-20, or £1,570.40 if under 18 or an apprentice.

rules.description: Applicant's adjusted net income must not exceed £100,000
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot get Tax-Free Childcare if your adjusted net income is over £100,000 for the current tax year

rules.description: Partner (if applicable) must be working, on leave, starting work, or receiving specific benefits
rules.reason_if_failed: Your partner must also be working or receiving Incapacity Benefit, Severe Disablement Allowance, Carer's Allowance/Support Payment, or contribution-based ESA

rules.description: Partner (if applicable) must earn at least National Minimum Wage for 16 hours per week
rules.reason_if_failed: Your partner must also expect to earn at least the equivalent of National Minimum Wage for 16 hours a week

rules.description: Partner's adjusted net income must not exceed £100,000
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot get Tax-Free Childcare if your partner's adjusted net income is over £100,000 for the current tax year

rules.description: Applicant must have a National Insurance number
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have a National Insurance number to apply

rules.description: Applicant must have British/Irish citizenship, settled/pre-settled status, or permission to access public funds
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be a British or Irish citizen, have settled or pre-settled status, or have permission to access public funds

rules.description: Cannot claim Tax-Free Childcare while receiving Universal Credit childcare element
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot get Tax-Free Childcare at the same time as claiming Universal Credit childcare element. Use the childcare calculator to see which is best for you.

rules.description: Cannot claim Tax-Free Childcare while receiving childcare vouchers or directly contracted childcare
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot get Tax-Free Childcare at the same time as receiving childcare vouchers. You must tell your employer to stop them within 90 days of applying.

rules.description: Childcare provider must be registered/approved for the scheme
rules.reason_if_failed: Your childcare provider must be signed up to the Tax-Free Childcare scheme. Check with them before applying.

explanation_template: Tax-Free Childcare eligibility: {outcome}. Government will top up by £2 for every £8 you pay in (up to £500 per quarter per child, or £1,000 if disabled).

edge_cases.description: Child is disabled (certified blind/severely sight-impaired or receives DLA/PIP/AFIP/CDP/ADP)
edge_cases.action: Higher quarterly limit applies: £1,000 instead of £500. Can use extra money for specialist equipment. Eligible until September after 16th birthday.
Minimum income requirement does not apply. Still eligible regardless of current earnings.

edge_cases.description: Applicant or partner is a company director without regular PAYE
edge_cases.action: May need to provide additional evidence of meeting minimum income: wage slips, bank statements, accountant statement, invoices, or annual payroll. Required at first application and each reconfirmation.
Can use average expected earnings over the full tax year instead of next 3 months. Example: £10,158.72 per year = £2,539.68 per quarter average.

edge_cases.description: Parents are separated but jointly responsible for child
edge_cases.action: Both parents must decide who applies. If cannot agree, both apply separately and HMRC will decide who gets the account. Only one parent can have an account per child.

edge_cases.description: Childcare provider is based in an EEA country
edge_cases.action: Contact HMRC to check if provider is eligible. Special rules may apply.

edge_cases.description: Living in EU/Switzerland/Norway/Iceland/Liechtenstein but working in UK
edge_cases.action: May still be eligible if work in UK started before 1 January 2021 and worked in UK at least once every 12 months since. Must show Frontier Worker permit when applying.

edge_cases.description: Partner is or will be absent from household for more than 6 months, or is a prisoner
edge_cases.action: Partner's employment and income will not affect eligibility. Apply as single parent.

edge_cases.description: Applicant or partner receives childcare vouchers but wants to switch
edge_cases.action: Must tell employer within 90 days of Tax-Free Childcare application to stop vouchers. May need to provide evidence to HMRC. Wait for Tax-Free Childcare decision before cancelling vouchers.

edge_cases.description: Currently claiming Universal Credit but wants to switch to Tax-Free Childcare
edge_cases.action: Wait until you get a decision on Tax-Free Childcare before cancelling Universal Credit claim. Use childcare calculator to check which is better for you.
